content: Custody tracking converges on hybrid: append-only event table (ASSIGN/TRANSFER/RETURN/DISPOSE with from/to, timestamp, actor) as immutable history + denormalized current-state pointer (current_holder on asset) for fast 'who has it now' queries, updated in the same transaction. Full event sourcing machinery (replay, projections) is overkill unless state reconstruction matters; thoughtbot warns concurrent transitions need guarding (irrelevant for single user).
